decision.text: Replacement of manual visual final inspection of MD-200 gearbox housings by an image-recognition model from 1 July 2025, after three months of parallel operation and with a 5% manual sample.

purpose: Detect more defects in a medical device component while keeping the quality system compliant.
decided_by: Board of Directors of Sernfeld Antriebstechnik AG

owner.name: Dr. Nadia Rüegg
owner.role: Head of Regulatory Affairs and Quality

restrictions: Three months of parallel operation before go-live

facts.text: MD-200 is a class I device with no notified body involved

law.text: 2 Produkte müssen unter Berücksichtigung ihrer Zweckbestimmung den grundlegenden Sicherheits- und Leistungsanforderungen nach Anhang I EU-MDR genügen.
law.proposition: Devices must meet the general safety and performance requirements of Annex I EU-MDR.

law.article_label: Art. 46 — Anbringen des Konformitätskennzeichens und klinische Bewertung
law.text: 1 Die Hersteller gewährleisten beim Inverkehrbringen oder bei der Inbetriebnahme ihrer Produkte, dass diese gemäss den Anforderungen dieser Verordnung konzipiert und hergestellt wurden.
law.proposition: When placing a device on the market, the manufacturer ensures that it was designed and manufactured in accordance with the ordinance, which covers changes to the final inspection.

law.description: EU regulation on artificial intelligence: high-risk classification of AI used as a safety component of a medical device, as assessed by EU counsel
law.proposition: The inspection model is not a high-risk AI system while the MD-200 remains a class I device without notified-body involvement.
